title: Multihash address action algebra

carrier.byteString: An exact finite Uint8Array, represented at the JSON boundary by canonical unpadded base64url.
carrier.commitment: A multihash binary value containing a hash algorithm code, digest length, and digest bytes.
carrier.presentation: The commitment bytes encoded as canonical lower-case base32 with its multibase prefix.

create-multihash.precondition: bytes is admitted as an exact byte string and algorithm is sha2-256 or sha2-512
create-multihash.postcondition: returns the unique canonical base32 presentation produced by the selected hasher for those bytes

read-multihash.precondition: address is one canonical base32 presentation of one supported complete multihash
read-multihash.postcondition: returns its algorithm, digest, binary carrier, and unchanged canonical presentation

verify-multihash.precondition: bytes is admitted and address satisfies read-multihash
verify-multihash.postcondition: matches is true exactly when creating under the address algorithm yields that address

laws: create(bytes) is deterministic for a fixed algorithm
read refuses alternate or noncanonical textual and binary presentations
nonClaims: A multihash does not identify a content codec, semantic referent, owner, authority, location, or storage provider.
Matching commitments do not prove provenance or authorization.
Cryptographic injectivity is an assumption, not a law proved by this service.
